merge_request.title: Remove the virtual kind from the Artifact Registry repository filter
merge_request.description:
## What does this MR do and why?

Virtual repositories are not supported yet in the Artifact Registry
organization UI. This MR removes the Virtual option from the Type
filter in the repositories list, leaving Hosted and Remote. It also
removes the mention of virtual repositories from the delete
repository confirmation text.

The search bar placeholder now reads "Filter repositories by type"
to better describe the filter. The `REPOSITORY_KIND_TOKEN` constant
moved out of the shared `constants.js` file into
`repositories_toolbar.vue`, since it is only used there. The `i18n`
blocks in both files were replaced with inline strings, since none
of the strings repeat. This change is behind the default-off feature
flag `artifact_registry_ui`.

## References

https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ops/artifact-registry/-/work_items/1263+s

## Screenshots or screen recordings

| Before | After |
|--------|-------|
|        |       |

Screenshots will be added.

## How to set up and validate locally

1. Enable the feature flag in the rails console:
   `Feature.enable(:artifact_registry_ui)`.
1. Open an organization's Artifact Registry repositories list.
1. Click the search bar and check that the Type token offers only
   Hosted and Remote, and that the placeholder reads
   "Filter repositories by type".
1. Open a repository, choose delete, and check that the
   confirmation text no longer mentions virtual repositories.

## MR acceptance checklist

Evaluate this MR against the [MR acceptance checklist](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/code_review/#acceptance-checklist).
It helps you analyze changes to reduce risks in quality, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

commits.title: Remove the virtual kind from the Artifact Registry repository filter
commits.message:
Remove the virtual kind from the Artifact Registry repository filter

Virtual repositories are not supported yet, so remove that option
from the repository Type filter and from the delete confirmation
text. Update the search placeholder to reflect the type filter.

Move the kind token constant out of the shared file since only
the toolbar component used it, and drop unused imports left behind.

Drop the i18n blocks in both files and inline each string, since
none of them repeat. Update the pot file and specs to match.

Render the manifest digest in the default semibold text style
instead of monospace, to match the rest of the table.

EE: true
